Subject: Throughput + errors up after today's model push (v5.2 quant)

Hi Soojin / Ben —

We're seeing a material regression in our API after the v5.2 quantized profile you rolled for us this morning. Key observations from 07:30–09:00 PT: p95 latency up ~3.1x, error rate (5xx) jumped to ~18–22%, and sustained throughput dropped by ~40%. I attached a snapshot (error_snapshot_20280718.json).

This is triggering downstream retries on our side and impacting our production workflows. We rolled back client-side retries but still see throttling. Can you confirm whether this rollout included any packaging or kernel changes beyond the quant profile? We need an ETA on a mitigation plan — our CTO is asking for immediate next steps.

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput + errors up after today's model push (v5.2 quant)

Quick triage notes (runtime):
- I compared the v5.2 quant profile with v5.1 — see attached quant-profile-diff.txt. The v5.2 profile enabled an asymmetric int8 kernel path and bumped max-batch-size heuristics for the default route.
- Under VerityCare's traffic shape (many small requests with occasional bursts), we're observing:
  * decode stalls at high concurrency due to a fallback to a slower kernel when certain alignment conditions hit (logs below).
  * increased memory churn / KV cache eviction rate which causes cold-cache penalties for p95.
  * a ~2–3x increase in scheduling latency for hot paths when batching is enabled.

Log excerpt (abridged):
[2028-07-18T08:58:12Z] decode_step: kernel_fallback True; elapsed_ms=42
[2028-07-18T08:58:12Z] kv_cache_evict key=conv-9; free_gb=3.2->2.1
[2028-07-18T08:59:05Z] schedule_delay batch_size=16 queued=48

Recommendation: immediate rollback to v5.1 quant profile for VerityCare (command: rollout set-profile veritycare v5.1 —force). Also: temporarily disable batching for their route and reduce max-concurrency to limit stall amplification. Plan attached as rollback_plan.md.

If Soojin approves, I can trigger the rollback and monitor a canary (30% traffic) for 20 minutes before full switch.

(attachment: quant-profile-diff.txt)
— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Lead, Serving Runtime

Alicia —

Thanks — we've validated the behavior Jonas described in our staging traces and recommend the following runbook:

1) Immediate: schedule rollback to v5.1 for VerityCare route at 2028-07-18T23:00:00Z (we'll start with a 30% canary for 20m).
2) Temporary mitigations (effective immediately): disable batching on the route, reduce max-concurrency by 40%, increase retry budget on our side to prevent client-level thrash.
3) Post-rollback: run a focused test sweep on your top 50 QPS endpoints and share a short report.

We will not change any customer billing or quota while we remediate. Attached is the rollback_plan.md with step-by-step commands and escalation contacts. If you give the go-ahead I will authorize Jonas to execute the canary tonight.

Please reply with a short "GO" if you authorize the rollback. If your CTO wants to join a quick 15-minute sync before the rollback, we can set that up.
